approach: In crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, an item's second failure ends as `ItemEnd::Failed(Failure)` with `Failure { reason, shared: Option<String> }`. `shared` is Some only on positive evidence of a cause that is not a verdict on the item: (a) `athena_core::disk::StopCause::of(reason).is_environment()` on a run that ended `Failed` or with no outcome, or on a read Err with no job; (b) a typed `GhFailure` (found by `downcast_ref`, which sees through anyhow context) in the Err arm of `landing_from_report`, with status 401, 403, 429 or 500..=599, or with no status and `transient_reason()` Some (timeout, connection reset). Every other run, read or landing Err is per item, including all job-state bails (declined, running, interrupted, already closed, readings cap, verification does not hold). `Drain::finish` passes a lone failure over with a note, like Paused and Skipped. It stops with `Stop::RepeatedFailure` only when an earlier different item holds the same shared key, with check and insert in one lock section. The operator-facing text is updated everywhere it states the old rule: drain.rs docs, display.rs, the `athena drain --help` stop list in main.rs, README.md, docs/spec.toml, docs/design/async-drain.md, CHANGELOG.md, and a new appended docs/decisions.md entry D154. A test reads those files and fails if the old wording is back.

decisions.choice: A no-outcome run or read Err is per item by default; it is shared only when `StopCause::of(text).is_environment()` holds. A `Failed` outcome is shared on the same test. Rejected, TimedOut and Failed with a Work reason are never shared. `Run`, `Read` and `RealSteps::run` get no new field.
decisions.reason: The Err sites are item-specific: run/mod.rs 340 declined, 348 running, 356 interrupted, 360 already closed; run/pin.rs 150 readings cap; run/close.rs 412 verification does not hold. `RealSteps::run` turns them all into `outcome: None`, so equal masked texts across items would stop the batch falsely. Typed host errors that the Err arm already knows (`BudgetShort`, `LowDisk`) set `held`, so they are never a Failed item. The producer's usage-limit and expired-login stops arrive as `Failed` outcomes with those reasons and the same test catches them.

decisions.choice: Add `Landing::HostError { why, key }`, returned only from the Err arm of `landing_from_report` when a new pure `host_cause(&anyhow::Error) -> Option<String>` finds a `GhFailure` with status 401, 403, 429 or 500..=599, or with no status and `transient_reason()` Some. Key: `host: github <status>` or `host: github <transient reason>`. A status-less failure that is not transient (for example not logged in, not found), 404, 405, 422 and non-gh errors stay `NotLanded(text)`, as does the Ok arm (red, green, none checks). `LandStep::NotLanded` becomes `NotLanded { host_cause: Option<String> }`; `Drain::land` writes `landing = "not landed: <why>"` as before. `landing_from_report` becomes `pub`.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 4: a gh failure with no HTTP status is shared only when the existing typed classifier `GhFailure::transient_reason` (transport.rs 87-106) reads it as a network fault; otherwise it is as likely to concern one pull request. Auth, rate-limit and server statuses concern the host for every item. Red CI is a verdict on the item. The key comes from the typed status or reason, not from text with a pull-request number, so matching cannot be defeated by per-item data. `pub` lets criteria 3 and 4 build landings with production code.

decisions.choice: Keys: for LowDisk, CheckTimeout, ProducerAuth and UsageLimit the key is the StopCause Debug text; for OtherEnvironment it is `failure_key(reason, names)`. `failure_key(text, names) -> Option<String>` lower-cases, splits on whitespace, trims edge punctuation (backtick, parentheses, quotes, comma, colon, full stop, semicolon) and a trailing `'s`, masks whole tokens equal to a name (item or retry job), job-id-shaped tokens and all-digit tokens, and joins with single spaces. An empty result is None and never matches. `State.failures: Vec<(String, String)>` holds shared keys only.
decisions.reason: Whole-token masking keeps item `a` from corrupting words. Wrapped ids are real: close.rs 348 writes run `athena go {id}` again, which gives a token with a trailing backtick, so matching works only if edge punctuation is trimmed. A unit test states it for backticks and parentheses (criterion 5).

decisions.choice: Check and insert into `State.failures` in one `self.st()` section in `Drain::finish`. The failed item stays in `report.queued` and is not tried again this run.
decisions.reason: Two concurrent workers (`drain_concurrent`) cannot both miss each other. It behaves like Paused and Skipped and adds no Report field, so the JSON and the display prefix `repeated failure: item X failed twice` are unchanged. No Steps method is called with the lock held.

risks.risk: A true shared cause is missed, so the batch pauses items one at a time (a gh outage during a run, a Failed run with a non-environment text, an OtherEnvironment text with per-item data masking does not remove, a status-less non-transient gh failure).
risks.mitigation: Named environment causes are keyed by StopCause kind, landing host errors by typed status or transient reason; only OtherEnvironment text is masked. A miss pauses more items, each with a visible note, and budget and job limit bound the run.

risks.risk: Two unrelated verdicts with the same fixed sentence (critic reject, planning cap, 'checks failed after rebase') are taken as a shared cause.
risks.mitigation: Only Failed or no-outcome results with an environment StopCause, and Landing::HostError, can be shared. Rejected, TimedOut, Work-reason Failed, pull-request-state NotLanded and the after-rebase recheck never are. Criteria 2 and 3 run controls through the drain.

risks.risk: A 401/403 gh failure may concern one pull request, so two such items stop the batch.
risks.mitigation: A stop is the conservative outcome and a note names both items. The criterion 4 unit test pins the split; 404, 405, 422 and non-transient status-less failures are per item.

risks.risk: Tests pass by relying on the stub's own text rather than production classification.
risks.mitigation: Doubles return scripted Run and Landing values only. Shared causes use production constants and typed GhFailure; landings are built by production `landing_from_report`; per-item controls use real bail formats.

risks.risk: The Before::RepeatedFailure seeding runs two workers with timing waits, and a second failing item changes the order.
risks.mitigation: Reseed with `errors` for bad and bad2 and wait for `end bad2-retry`; the loop already waits for the entry and then 150 ms for the stop to be stored. Keep asserted row counts and run the whole file.

risks.risk: A failed item stays in `report.queued`, so the next `athena drain` retries it and a permanently failing item repeats across runs.
risks.mitigation: Matches Paused and Skipped items; the note says 'paused for this run'. A persistent pause would touch the scope guard, out of scope.

risks.risk: With merge_via_rest off, a drain now burns its budget across the whole queue.
risks.mitigation: Bounded by --budget and --job-limit; each item has a visible note; README.md says so; recorded as a User question.

risks.risk: The decisions.md edit breaks line-pinned backtest links or the supersession hit count.
risks.mitigation: Append only at the end, no edit to D98, D154 avoids the phrases `superseded by`, `supersedes`, `amends`; the full `cargo test --locked` runs backtest.rs and ontology.rs.

demonstrations.method: For each real per-item text, one serial drain of a, b, c with `Stub.runs` scripted as `(None, text)` for the four runs of a and b (a, a, b, b), then c landing by default. Texts use the real format strings with each job's own name: `job {id} is already closed (rejected)` (run/mod.rs 360), `job {id} has 12 readings, the most a job may have; close it and ask again` (pin.rs 150), `job {id} was declined: ...` (340), `job {id} is running` (348), `job {id} was interrupted: its process died before it closed. ...` (356), `job {id}'s verification does not hold for its candidate any more; ask again` (close.rs 412).
